reason: My doctor said my magnesium could be low and I always forget pills at home, so a counted sachet I can toss in my bag is what I'd actually use. The named lab report and the money-back guarantee make one box at the launch price an easy try.
objection: Why only one form of magnesium when other brands put several forms in one capsule? I don't know if bisglycinate alone is enough for what my doctor meant.
